#Monday's main take home messages

##What I did 

	1) Getting used to git version controls 
	2) Creating an initial blog with Quarto 
  
##What I learned

	1) git clone (from a github link) 
	2) git checkout -b "name_of_branch" :  create my own branch
	3) modify the required file 
	4) git status
	5) git diff ( the differneces) 
	6) git add . 
	7) git commit -m "write what I have done"
	8) git push 
	9) git fetch origin (name of another branch)
	10)git merge origin/the branch 
	11) do the modification again , save , git add, git commit, push
